categories_checked.note: Service-Public F12214 (BCS), F32456 (list of student aids), F1024 (aide spécifique annuelle), F34343 (aide mobilité master), Campus France Eiffel page.
Service-Public F12006 (APL), caf.fr news on the 1 July 2026 reform for non-EU students, Service-Public F33453 (Visale).
Service-Public F10027 (Complémentaire santé solidaire). Basic affiliation is free (see bureaucracy).
TCL tariff guide (solidaire réduit for scholarship students); IDFM pages blocked, imagine R recorded in bureaucracy as unverified. No Paris-wide student transport subsidy page reached.
Service-Public F2882 (prime d'activité, conditions for foreign nationals).
Service-Public F378 and F380: only outgoing measures (Erasmus+ grant and aide à la mobilité internationale). No French national top-up for incoming Erasmus+ students found.
Attempted: Île-de-France and Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes regional mobility-grant pages returned 404 or a bot challenge, and the search budget ran out. Two records kept as missing.

Sciences Po (Emile-Boutmy, €400 aid), École Polytechnique bachelor aid, Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships, ENS de Lyon scholarships, Sorbonne / Paris 1 / Lyon 2 pages on differentiated fees and exemptions, PSL financial aid page.

items.name_it: Borsa di studio su criteri sociali (CROUS)
items.description: Needs-based state grant paid in 10 monthly instalments, scale 0 bis to 7, also exempting from registration fees and CVEC. EU/EEA/Swiss/Andorran students qualify only if they have worked in France (full or part time) or a parent has received income in France.

eligibility.income_test: means-tested on family income (scale 0 bis to 7)
eligibility.min_work_hours: any employment in France, full or part time (no threshold stated), or a parent with income in France

items.amount: €1,454 to €6,335 per year (2026-2027, scale 0 bis to 7)
items.how_to_apply: Dossier social étudiant (DSE) online via 'Mes services étudiant'.
items.stackable: Combinable with aide au mérite, aide à la mobilité internationale and aide à la mobilité master (Service-Public F380, F34343).

interpretations.hypothesis: Maximum is €6,335/year (scale 7, 2026-2027), plus €300/year for overseas students
Service-Public's overview of student aids says the BCS goes 'up to €7,602/year'

items.notes: Sciences Po's page words the EU condition as 'studied in France for at least one year'; Service-Public's wording (work in France or parent's income in France) is used here.

items.name_it: Borsa di studio su criteri sociali (CROUS)
items.description: Same needs-based grant; non-EU nationals must hold a residence permit, have lived in France for at least 2 years and belong to a tax household in France for at least 2 years. Refugees and subsidiary-protection holders can also qualify.

eligibility.residence_requirement: residence permit + domiciled in France for at least 2 years + tax household in France for at least 2 years

items.how_to_apply: Dossier social étudiant (DSE) online.

items.name_it: Aiuto d'urgenza annuale del CROUS
items.description: Annual aid for students in lasting financial difficulty who do not receive the BCS, decided by a commission after a social assessment; also exempts from registration fees.

eligibility.income_test: lasting financial difficulty; family income abroad cannot be used to assess eligibility
other: same diploma, study and nationality conditions as the BCS

items.amount: €1,454 to €6,335 per year (BCS scales 0 bis to 7)
items.how_to_apply: Contact the social service of your regional CROUS.
items.stackable: Combinable with aide à la mobilité internationale and aide au mérite.
items.notes: Nationality conditions follow the BCS (see fr-bcs-eu / fr-bcs-non-eu).

items.name_local: Aide à la mobilité pour l'inscription en Master 1
items.name_it: Aiuto alla mobilità per l'iscrizione al Master 1
items.description: One-off €1,000 for BCS (or aide spécifique annuelle) holders who just obtained a licence and enrol for the first time in Master 1 at a university in a different region.

eligibility.income_test: must hold the BCS or the allocation annuelle spécifique
other: licence obtained the previous year (not licence professionnelle)
university in a different region from the licence

items.how_to_apply: Send the licence certificate and M1 enrolment certificate; paid by the CROUS the month after.
items.stackable: Combinable with Bourse Talents, aide au mérite, aide spécifique ponctuelle.
items.notes: Foreign students are not addressed on the page; in practice they need the BCS first.

items.name_it: Borsa di eccellenza Eiffel
items.authority: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères / Campus France
items.description: Excellence scholarship for foreign students at master's and PhD level. Students cannot apply directly: the French institution submits the application.

other: master: 29 at most; PhD: 35 at most
nomination by a French higher-education institution

items.how_to_apply: Through the French host institution, which submits the file to Campus France.
items.deadline: Institutions submit by 6 January 2027 (session 2027); results the week of 12 April 2027
items.stackable: Not combinable with the Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarship (Paris-Saclay rules).
items.notes: Monthly amount is in the 2027 regulations PDF, which could not be read (HTTP 503). Whether EU nationals are eligible is not stated on the page.

items.name_it: Contributo affitto CAF (APL/ALS)
items.description: Monthly housing aid for tenants, co-tenants and residents of approved student residences, based on rent, household income of the last 12 months and assets above €30,000. EU/EEA/Swiss students are not affected by the July 2026 restriction.

eligibility.income_test: household resources over the past 12 months; assets above €30,000 counted; excluded if attached to parents' tax household paying IFI
other: housing is main residence in France and decent

items.amount: No fixed amount: use the CAF simulator
items.how_to_apply: Create a CAF account and apply online; processing about 36.5 days on average; paid from the month after the request.
items.stackable: Your parents lose family benefits for you, but you may stay in their tax household.
items.notes: Whether exchange students qualify is not addressed separately on these pages.

items.name_local: Aide personnalisée au logement (APL) / ALS – étudiants extracommunautaires
items.name_it: Contributo affitto CAF per studenti extra-UE (dal 1° luglio 2026)
items.description: Since 1 July 2026, non-EU/EEA/Swiss students holding a long-stay visa or residence permit for studies get housing aid only if they hold a social-criteria higher-education scholarship (CROUS or certain regional health/social scholarships), have a professional activity (employee or self-employed), or are apprentices / on a professionalisation contract. Refugees and stateless persons remain eligible. Erasmus+ grants do not count.

eligibility.income_test: same CAF means test as other tenants
eligibility.min_work_hours: professional activity required if no scholarship; no minimum hours stated
other: holder of a student visa or 'poursuite d'études' residence permit

items.amount: No fixed amount: use the CAF simulator
items.how_to_apply: Online on caf.fr; run the simulator first.

interpretations.hypothesis: caf.fr: the qualifying scholarship is a 'bourse d'enseignement supérieur sur critères sociaux' (CROUS or certain regional health/social scholarships); professional activity also keeps eligibility
Service-Public: the three alternative conditions are a CROUS or regional social-criteria scholarship, a professional activity, or an apprenticeship/professionalisation contract

items.notes: Neither page sets a minimum number of work hours; a human should confirm how CAF treats very small jobs.

items.name_it: Garanzia Visale (garante gratuito per l'affitto)
items.description: Free rent guarantee replacing a personal guarantor for students and work-study students under 30. Île-de-France: rent up to €1,000 with no resource condition, up to €1,940 if resources exceed €2,000. Elsewhere: €840 or €680 without proof of resources depending on the commune (up to €1,575 / €1,365 with resources).

other: under 30 at lease signature (Île-de-France: at least 17 years 10 months)
private, social, university residence or foyer housing

items.amount: Guarantee (not a payment): rent covered up to €1,000/month in Île-de-France without resource condition (2026)
items.how_to_apply: Create an account on visale.fr before signing the lease, get the visa, give it to the landlord.
items.notes: The page does not say whether foreign (non-EU) students or a specific visa are required; visale.fr refuses automated access. Confirm with Action Logement.

items.name_it: Assicurazione sanitaria complementare gratuita o agevolata (C2S)
items.description: Free or low-cost complementary health cover for low-income residents. Foreigners need a valid residence permit and more than 3 months of uninterrupted residence (shorter stays may qualify for study or work over 3 months).

eligibility.income_test: single person, mainland France: free up to €10,421/year; with contribution up to €14,069/year
eligibility.residence_requirement: valid residence permit for foreigners; enrolment in a French institution is a qualifying situation

items.amount: Free, or with a monthly contribution depending on income
items.how_to_apply: Online in your ameli account, or cerfa 12504 to the CPAM.
items.notes: Whether EU students covered by an EHIC can apply is not stated.

items.name_it: Abbonamento TCL solidale ridotto (Lione)
items.description: Reduced all-zones TCL pass for scholarship students up to 27 living in a commune of TCL zones 1 to 5 (Lyon area).

eligibility.income_test: must be a scholarship holder ('étudiant boursier')
eligibility.residence_requirement: living in a commune of TCL zones 1-5

items.how_to_apply: On tcl.fr or at a TCL agency with proof of scholarship.

items.name_local: Prise en charge employeur des abonnements (prime transport)
items.name_it: Rimborso del 50% dell'abbonamento da parte del datore di lavoro
items.description: Employees, including students with a job, get at least 50% of their public transport pass reimbursed by the employer.
items.amount: At least 50% of the pass price
items.how_to_apply: Give the employer proof of purchase (attestation downloadable on tcl.fr).

items.name_it: Esenzione fiscale dei redditi da lavoro degli studenti
items.description: Salaries earned by students under 26 are exempt from income tax up to three times the gross monthly SMIC; only the excess is taxable. Internship allowances have a separate exemption. State/local social-criteria grants are not taxable.

other: applies to French income tax returns (own return or parents' tax household)

items.amount: Up to €5,405 of salary exempt (2026 return on 2025 income); internship allowance exempt up to €21,622 (2025)
items.how_to_apply: Declare only the amount above the cap on the income tax return.
items.stackable: Combinable with the internship allowance exemption.
items.notes: The page's age wording is inconsistent between sections (under 25 vs under 26 on 1 January); confirm on impots.gouv.fr.

items.name_it: Integrazione al reddito per chi lavora (prime d'activité)
items.description: Monthly top-up for people aged 18+ with modest earnings from work. EU nationals need a right of residence and at least 3 months of residence in France.

eligibility.income_test: modest household income; flat amount €638.28 for a single person + 59.85% of earnings, minus resources
eligibility.min_work_hours: professional activity required (no hour threshold stated on the page)
eligibility.stay_duration: at least 3 months of residence in France

items.amount: Calculated case by case (base flat amount €638.28, 2026); not paid under €15/month
items.how_to_apply: Online on caf.fr; CAF simulator available.
items.notes: The page does not give the student-specific earnings threshold; a human should confirm student conditions on caf.fr. Swiss nationals treated like EU here is an assumption: the page speaks of EU nationals.

items.name_it: Prime d'activité per cittadini extra-UE
items.description: Non-EU nationals qualify only with at least 5 years of a residence permit allowing work, a carte de résident, refugee/stateless/subsidiary-protection status, or as single parents of a child under 3. Most newly arrived non-EU students therefore do not qualify.

eligibility.residence_requirement: at least 5 years with a residence permit allowing work, or carte de résident / refugee / stateless / subsidiary protection

items.how_to_apply: Online on caf.fr.

items.name_it: Erasmus+ in entrata in Francia
items.description: Incoming Erasmus+ students are paid by their home country. No French national top-up for incoming students was found; they are not concerned by the CVEC if they pay no registration fees in France, and an Erasmus+ grant does not keep non-EU students eligible for housing aid.
items.notes: Absence of a top-up = not found on Service-Public F378, not an explicit statement. The 'Erasmus+ does not count for APL' point comes from a press article (letudiant.fr) seen only in search results; caf.fr lists only social-criteria scholarships as qualifying.

items.name_it: Aiuto alla mobilità internazionale (studenti iscritti in Francia in uscita)
items.authority: Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur, paid by the home French institution
items.description: For students enrolled in France who hold the BCS or aide spécifique annuelle and go abroad for an exchange or internship of 1 to 10 consecutive months; selected by the institution. Combinable with Erasmus+.

eligibility.income_test: must hold the BCS or allocation annuelle spécifique
other: preparing a national diploma in a French institution

items.how_to_apply: Form from your institution's international relations office.
items.stackable: Combinable with Erasmus+ grant (F378) and aide au mérite (F380).

items.name_local: Aide régionale à la mobilité internationale des étudiants (Île-de-France)
items.name_it: Aiuto regionale alla mobilità internazionale (Île-de-France)
items.description: Not verified: the regional page could not be reached today. Whether an Erasmus+/mobility top-up exists for outgoing or incoming students, and its amount, is unknown.

items.name_it: Borsa regionale di mobilità internazionale (Alvernia-Rodano-Alpi)
items.description: Not verified: the regional aid page returned a bot challenge. Amount and conditions unknown.

items.name_it: Borsa Émile-Boutmy (Sciences Po)
items.description: Tuition exemption for excellent first-time applicants from outside the EU whose household does not file taxes in the EU. Bachelor: total exemption or €9,500 exemption; Master: €18,500 exemption per year for two years. Swiss and Norwegian applicants, PhD, 1-year master and exchange students are excluded.

eligibility.income_test: household not filing taxes in the EU

items.amount: Bachelor: full or €9,500/year tuition exemption; Master: €18,500/year exemption
items.how_to_apply: Tick the scholarship in the 'Financial information' section of the Sciences Po application (Parcoursup applicants: online form after validation).
items.deadline: Bachelor (foreign school leavers): 13 January 2027; French-school applicants: 1 April 2027; Master: 18 October or 29 November (year not stated)

items.name_local: Aide financière Sciences Po (étudiants sans bourse CROUS)
items.name_it: Aiuto finanziario Sciences Po per studenti UE senza borsa CROUS
items.description: Students without a CROUS grant whose income-based tuition is calculated at €0 receive €400 per year (€200 for one semester). Tuition at Sciences Po is calculated on family income for EU/EEA students.

eligibility.income_test: tuition fees calculated at €0 on family income

items.how_to_apply: Paid after administrative registration.

items.name_local: Bourses et aides – Bachelor de l'École polytechnique
items.name_it: Borse e aiuti del Bachelor dell'École polytechnique
items.description: Merit: Excellence and Women in Science scholarships of €4,800/year for 3 years; full scholarship for international Olympiad medallists (up to €87,900 non-EU / €78,750 EU per student, tuition waived except €1,500/year fee). Need-based: tuition waiver and/or 0% loan for students not eligible for CROUS; EU/EEA nationals can apply to CROUS from the second year.

eligibility.income_test: need-based waivers depend on family resources
other: €1,500 non-refundable annual fee for need-based applicants

items.how_to_apply: Instructions sent to admitted students; apply after admission, early.
items.deadline: After admission results, before the pre-registration fee deadline
items.stackable: Olympiad full scholarship not combinable with other school, Foundation or French government aid.
items.notes: Academic year of the figures is not stated on the page.

items.name_it: Borse internazionali per Master (Université Paris-Saclay)
items.description: €10,000/year paid monthly September–June plus up to €900/year travel/visa allowance, for foreign students admitted to an eligible Paris-Saclay master's, enrolling for the first time in a French institution, under 30. M1 laureates are renewed for M2.

other: first enrolment in a French higher-education institution (prior exchange does not count)
not combinable with Eiffel, Europa or Erasmus Mundus

items.how_to_apply: Apply to the master's; course coordinators pre-select, then an online scholarship form.
items.deadline: 2026 cycle: 31 March 2026 (2027 dates not yet published)
items.stackable: Not combinable with Eiffel, France Excellence Europa or Erasmus Mundus.

items.name_local: Bourses d'excellence Ampère / GRADUATE+ (ENS de Lyon)
items.name_it: Borse di eccellenza Ampère / GRADUATE+ (ENS de Lyon)
items.description: Master's scholarships for international students: Ampère €1,000/month for one academic year (renewable under conditions); GRADUATE+ €1,000/month for 10 months for selected master's programmes. Normaliens admitted by competitive exam are paid (EU/EEA: €1,500/month).

other: international students admitted to an ENS de Lyon master's

items.how_to_apply: Via the ENS de Lyon 'Application process and deadlines' page.

items.name_local: Droits d'inscription différenciés et exonérations (universités publiques)
items.name_it: Tasse differenziate per studenti extra-UE ed esenzioni
items.authority: Universities (arrêté of 19 April 2019; decree of May 2026)
items.description: Non-EU/EEA students at public universities pay differentiated fees (e.g. Paris 1, 2026-2027: €2,902 licence, €3,950 master vs €178 / €255). Since a May 2026 decree universities may exempt up to 30% of non-EU students; Sorbonne says it can exempt all eligible applicants, Lyon 2 ended its general transitional exemption from 2026-2027. Scholarship holders (BCS) are exempt from fees.

other: exemption criteria set by each university
exchange students: fees normally paid at home institution

items.how_to_apply: University exemption procedure (Sorbonne: newly arrived non-EU students apply; Paris 1: file to exoneration office).

interpretations.hypothesis: The ministerial decree is dated 19 May 2026 (Sorbonne)
The new decree took effect on 21 May 2026 (Lyon 2)

items.notes: Fee amounts are Paris 1's published figures; other universities may differ. ENS de Lyon says exchange students under bilateral/Erasmus agreements are exempt from its tuition.

items.name_it: Aiuti finanziari PSL
items.description: PSL relies mainly on the CROUS need-based grant (DSE), merit scholarships, emergency aid for students under 35 and on-campus student jobs; it advises international students to check Campus France and home-country schemes. No PSL-specific international scholarship amount is given on the page.
items.how_to_apply: DSE on messervices.etudiant.gouv.fr; PSL graduate scholarships page.

items.name_it: Aiuto per l'acquisto del computer (Paris 1)
items.description: One-off €600 reimbursement for a computer purchase after commission review; tuition must be paid. Not open to incoming Erasmus, continuing-education or IAE students.

other: once per student (repeat after 3 years only in case of theft/failure)

items.how_to_apply: Application to the Paris 1 student life service; reimbursement on proof of purchase.
